rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday way to describe something relating to the human body.

example.english: The doctor said the injury would have lasting corporal effects.
example.traditional: 醫生話呢個傷對身體上嘅影響會持續好耐。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 ni1 go3 soeng1 deoi3 san1 tai2 soeng6 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 wui5 ci4 zuk6 hou2 noi6

rows.note: Use this when contrasting bodily experience with mental, spiritual, or non-physical experience.

example.english: Corporal suffering is different from spiritual suffering.
example.traditional: 肉體上嘅痛苦同精神上嘅痛苦唔一樣。
example.jyutping: juk6 tai2 soeng6 ge3 tung3 fu2 tung4 zing1 san4 soeng6 ge3 tung3 fu2 m4 jat1 joeng6
